 Judgment

The present appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 05.01.2012 in MVC.No.55/2011 passed by the Addl. MACT at Sagar, dismissing the claim petition with costs.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the records.
3.

Brief facts of the case are as under:
On 10.01.2020 at about 2.00., when the claimant was waiting at Varadahalli road to proceed towards Sagar, bike bearing No.KA-15/L-7744 came in a rash and negligent manner and dashed the petitioner.

As a result, the claimant sustained NC:
2023:KHC:21502 injuries to his face and left leg and was shifted to hospital.
The claimant who was working as a Gold Smith is unable to do any work due to accidental injuries and has spent huge sum of money for medical treatment.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant/claimant submitted that the Tribunal erroneously dismissed the claim petition only on the ground that since in the cross-examination, the claimant had admitted that there was no compromise entered between him and the driver of the motor-bike.

Therefore,
only on this ground, dismissed the claim petition.
The claimant is before this Court praying to allow the appeal and grant compensation by setting aside the Judgment and Award of the Tribunal.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the Tribunal has committed an error in dismissing the claim petition and prays for setting aside the Judgment and Award by allowing the appeal.
6. On the contrary, learned counsel for the Insurance Company submitted that the claimant had fallen from the bike and not hit by the motor-bike.

Therefore, the learned counsel NC:
2023:KHC:21502 justified the Judgment and Award passed by the Tribunal.
Hence, prays to dismiss the appeal.
7. In the present case, the accident was caused on 10.01.2010.
Complaint was lodged on 19.01.2010.
There is a delay of 09 days in lodging the complaint before the Police.

The explanation offered by the complainant for delay is that the rider of the motor-bike had initially consented to bear the medical expenses, but later on, he could not keep his promise for meeting medical expenses.
Therefore, with these reasons, there is delay in lodging the complaint.
The delay in lodging the complaint cannot always be made a ground for dismissal of the claim petition.
But the delay aspect has to be considered on the facts and circumstances in each case.

Ex.P14 is the case-sheet of Spandana Hospital in which it is stated that the claimant was admitted to the hospital on 10.01.2010 immediately after the accident and the information given to the hospital authorities that the claimant had fallen from motor- bike.

Therefore, the information regarding the incident/accident whether before the Police or hospital authorities or before any one else immediately after the accident at undisputed point of time, can carry more weightage NC: 2023:KHC:21502 than the information given before the Police if the statement before the Police is a belated one.

Therefore, in comparison with the information given before the Police as per Ex.P1 and the information given before the hospital authorities as per Ex.P14, the information given before the hospital authorizes carries more weightage than the information given before the Police in case where there is a delay in lodging the complaint.
It is the specific case of the Insurance Company that the claimant had fallen from the motor-bike.

The Insurance Company by relying on Ex.P14-case sheet and also got marked the information given/recorded in the case sheet as Ex.R1.
8.
It is not the case of the claimant that he was unconscious while being admitted to the hospital and somebody has given information to the hospital.
But the claimant was conscious and he has given information to the hospital authorities that he has fallen from the bike.
Therefore, the claimant's averments given in the claim petition was that he was waiting for the bus and some other bike hit him is not believable.

However, considering the evidence on record, in all its preponderance of probabilities, it is proved that the claimant had fallen from the motor-bike and admitted to the hospital NC: 2023:KHC:21502 and later on, to make claim against the Insurance Company,
belatedly complaint was lodged just to make claim against the Insurance Company.

In this type of proceedings, evidence can be appreciated on all its preponderance of probabilities as above Sri Guruprasad vs Sri Chandrashekar on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4583033/
